title: DyPSI: Dynamic Physics Sensing via Joint Field and Sensor-Trajectory Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06280v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics sensing in evolving environments requires reconstructing dense spatiotemporal fields from sparse observations while adapting where future observations should be collected. Existing reconstruction and sensor-placement methods have made substantial progress, but they typically rely on static sensing assumptions: they either use a single layout across all frames or optimize placements independently at each frame, which limits their ability to produce temporally coherent sensing trajectories. We introduce DyPSI, a dynamic physics sensing framework that formulates this problem as the joint generation of future fields and sensor trajectories conditioned on historical observations. DyPSI lifts discrete sensor coordinates into continuous Sensor Position Fields, encodes fields and sensing configurations with a shared Functional Tucker representation, and trains a joint diffusion model to generate future fields and sensing trajectories sim

translated_title: DyPSI：通过场与传感器轨迹联合生成实现动态物理感知
translated_abstract: 动态演化环境中的物理感知需要在稀疏观测的基础上重建稠密的时空场，同时自适应地决定未来观测应当在哪里采集。现有的重建与传感器布置方法已取得长足进展，但它们通常依赖于静态感知假设：要么在所有帧中使用单一的布置方案，要么在每一帧上独立地优化布置，这限制了其生成时间上连贯的感知轨迹的能力。我们提出了DyPSI，一个动态物理感知框架，它将该问题表述为以历史观测为条件的未来场与传感器轨迹的联合生成。DyPSI将离散的传感器坐标提升为连续的传感器位置场，利用共享的函数式Tucker表示对场和感知配置进行编码，并训练一个联合扩散模型来同时生成未来场与感知轨迹……
tldr: DyPSI提出了一种动态物理感知框架，通过连续传感器位置场、共享函数式Tucker表示与联合扩散模型，从历史观测中同时生成未来物理场和时间连贯的传感器运动轨迹，突破了传统静态传感器布置的局限。
